title: Celbridge asset entry
description: One asset listed in the Celbridge asset catalogue. Each asset is distributed under its own licence, stated at its url.

summary.description: Short plain-text description of the asset, typically 3-4 sentences.

tags.description: Free-form keywords for searching and filtering. May be an empty list.

min_version.description: Minimum Celbridge version the asset requires, e.g. "1.8" or "1.9.2".

url.description: URL of the asset's source repository, where its full licence text can be found.

thumbnail.description: Filename of the thumbnail image, in the same folder as this asset.json.

screenshot.description: Filename of the screenshot image, in the same folder as this asset.json.

updated.description: Date the asset entry was last updated, as YYYY-MM-DD.
